options.title: App name
options.description: The name shown under the copy's home screen icon. Up to 40 characters, starting with a letter or number.

options.title: Package name
options.description: The copy's unique app ID, like com.facebook.orca.hush. Use words joined by dots, each starting with a letter. It can't match Messenger or another Meta app.

name: Clone install under another package name
description: The name shown under the copy's home screen icon. Up to 40 characters, starting with a letter or number

name: Install beside Meta apps
description: Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch

name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
description: Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key, and lets Threads and Instagram video links open in a Threads or Instagram you patched yourself. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch

name: Material You theme
description: Colors Messenger's dark mode with your wallpaper colors on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue on Android 11. Light mode stays the same. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide inbox ads
description: Hides ad cards in your chat list. Meta stopped selling Messenger inbox ads in November 2025, so this is only a safeguard in case they come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide People You May Know
description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs, so you only see people you know. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide friend request cards
description: Hides friend request cards in your chat list so they stop taking up room. It doesn't accept or decline anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide joined community chats
description: Hides the community chats you joined from your main chat list. Search and community folders still show them. Messages and unread counts don't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide growth prompts
description: Hides prompts to add more people, the tip sheets in notes (like Make my notes public), and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide inbox promotions
description: Hides promotion banners in your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide stories and notes
description: Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide inbox tabs
description: Hides the Home and Channels tabs inside your inbox. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide Mark as read
description: Hides Mark as read in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list, so you can't mark a chat read by accident. Mark as unread stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Pin more chats
description: Raises Messenger's limit of three pinned chats to 20, so you can keep more chats at the top of your chat list. Messenger's servers can still stop you sooner. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide Meta AI
description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, plus AI in search and in @ suggestions. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide Chat Moments
description: Hides Chat Moments in the menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide Reels badge
description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide People tab
description: Hides the People tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide Notifications tab
description: Hides the Notifications tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hold stories at the end
description: Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide AI sticker tools
description: Hides the Generate AI sticker buttons, the AI sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide avatar stickers
description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Restore old emoji drawer
description: Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Keep emoji search on emoji
description: Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide chat promotions
description: Hides promotion banners inside conversations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide ad banners in business chats
description: In a chat you started from a business's ad, hides the banner that shows that ad. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide business reply suggestions
description: Hides suggested replies in conversations with businesses. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide business typing suggestions
description: Hides business suggestions that pop up as you type. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide event prompts
description: Hides event promotion prompts inside chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide typing indicator
description: Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Open web links externally
description: Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Allow chat bubbles
description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Native Bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Native Bubbles needs Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Use system emoji
description: Shows emoji in your phone's own style instead of Messenger's. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Send photos at original quality
description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo at its full size instead of Messenger's smaller copy, so it stays sharp. Location is still removed. Photos over 20 MB are still made smaller. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Send videos without re-encoding
description: Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Fix videos that won't send
description: Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, the sound is converted to regular AAC, or the tag is dropped, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages
description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Keep a message log
description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Auto reply
description: Answers messages with replies you write in HushMessenger settings, when they have words you pick or any message at all. Replies go out through Messenger's own notification reply, encrypted chats too, at most once every five minutes per chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Use the phone's camera app
description: The camera button in a chat opens your phone's own camera app. The photo then opens in Messenger's editor, ready to send. Photos only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Open your gallery app
description: The gallery button in a chat opens your phone's own gallery app. What you pick then opens in Messenger's editor for that chat, ready to send. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Stop analytics uploads
description: Stops the background services Messenger uses to upload usage statistics. It still records them on your phone, and they can upload after you turn this off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Stop ad attribution uploads
description: Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Stop inbox and ad link logging
description: Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Stop MQTT logging
description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger's MQTT client sends. Messenger sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Stop nearby scans
description: Stops Messenger from reading the list of Wi-Fi networks around you, and hides the name and hardware address of the one you're connected to, the way Android does when Messenger can't see your location. Also stops the timer it can run while it's open to check your location and scan for Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Stop app list and device ID sharing
description: Stops Messenger from going through the apps on your phone to find other Meta apps, and from asking them for the device ID Meta uses to link the apps on one phone. Messenger keeps the ID it already has. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Allow screenshots
description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, such as view-once photos and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. It doesn't add replay or saving. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Hide read receipts
description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself or replying in it marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Mark as read button
description: Puts Messenger's Mark as read icon in a chat's top bar while Hide read receipts is on. Opening the chat still sends nothing, and a tap on the icon sends Seen and marks the chat read. It takes the place of the chat details button, since tapping the chat's name opens the same page, so the call buttons stay put. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Keep unsent messages
description: Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, in chats where it works. Encrypted chats aren't supported, and group chats aren't tested. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Unlock app icons
description: Lets you pick any icon in Messenger's App icon setting without a subscription. Messenger still decides whether that setting shows for your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Use your own font
description: Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: View stories anonymously
description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Messenger still marks them as seen on your side. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Save any story
description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Slide chats in and out
description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Bold and italic text
description: Adds Bold and Italic to the menu that shows when you select words you typed. They're special Unicode letters, so they show on any phone, but screen readers may read them oddly. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls

name: Open settings from menu
description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch

options.title: Sound file
options.description: Your .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file, 1 MB or smaller. Leave it empty to keep Messenger's own sound.

name: Custom new-message sound
description: Your .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file, 1 MB or smaller. Leave it empty to keep Messenger's own sound

options.title: Version number
options.description: A whole number up to 2147483647, no lower than the Messenger you're patching. Pick one higher than Messenger's version in the Play Store, or it will keep offering updates. The default is the highest Android allows.

name: Spoof package version
description: A whole number up to 2147483647, no lower than the Messenger you're patching. Pick one higher than Messenger's version in the Play Store, or it will keep offering updates. The default is the highest Android allows
